label: Security Setup
narration: Day one. Dana opens Security Setup to create her encryption key and initialize the password store.

label: Pass unlock
narration: The pass store is initialized — RobOS asks for the GPG passphrase once to unlock it for the day.

label: Pass Manager
narration: Three credentials added — Jira token, GitHub PAT, and username — all encrypted on disk, visible only as asterisks.

label: Task Servers
narration: Task Servers connects RobOS to Acme's Jira. The API token loads straight from the password store.

label: Workflow Studio
narration: Workflow Studio — Dana describes the team in plain English and RobOS drafts the full ticket lifecycle.

label: Git Projects
narration: Git Projects — both repos registered. RobOS detects the stack and drafts dev-setup scripts automatically.

label: Wrap
narration: Three minutes, one source of truth. Every RobOS app picks it up from here.
